name: Meitantei Conan: Kigantou Hihou Densetsu
original_name: 名探偵コナン 奇岩島秘宝伝
source:
In this game you must play as Conan, Sonoko, and Kogoro, as they all obtain clues to solve the crime.
Miki and Satomi Togawa from the previous game return.

[From [url=https://www.detectiveconanworld.com/wiki/Detective_Conan:_Legend_of_the_Treasure_of_Strange_Rock_Island]Detectiveconanworld wiki[/url]]
translation:
在这款游戏中，你必须扮演柯南、园子和小五郎，因为他们都获得了破案的线索。
上一场比赛的三木和远川里美回归。

[摘自[url=https://www.detectiveconanworld.com/wiki/Detective_Conan:_Legend_of_the_Treasure_of_Strange_Rock_Island]名侦探柯南世界wiki[/url]]
